title: Synthesis of thermostable artificial nicotinamide cofactors: carba-NAD+ and carba-NADP+
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CB00036C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zinnia Dsouza, Jan-Simon Jeshua Friedrichs, Manuel Döring, Nicolás Rincón Téllez, Luca Schmermund, Volker Sieber
Carbocyclic nicotinamide cofactors are synthesized via chemical and enzymatic routes, with strategies compared to improve access to costly biomimetics. These artificial cofactors exhibit high thermostability and broad oxidoreductase compatibility.
